verdict.rationale: Ramp ships first-party agent channels that cover this loop. Ramp MCP and the AI Agents guide document searching transactions, loading accounting and tracking categories, edits, and approvals, with every action landing in the audit log. The open-source CLI's agent mode adds transactions list/get/edit/missing/flag-missing/explain-missing/memo-suggestions, so an agent can pull incomplete transactions, propose memos and coding, flag gaps, and write changes back for human approval. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that the transaction edit writes GL/accounting-category coding fields, a documented 'uncoded' filter (only missing receipts/memos is shown), API-level policy-violation flagging beyond missing-item flags, and independent hands-on corroboration.
